expected_level_description: You can: - maintain plans, registers, and trackers for several projects - collect updates and produce regular status reports - check that projects follow the agreed method
You can: - maintain plans, risk and issue logs, and reports - run project meetings and track actions - manage a small, well-defined project with support
You can: - build templates, trackers, and simple automated workflows - make documents accessible to everyone - help colleagues get the most from office tools
You can: - write accurate, concise minutes and action logs for routine meetings - follow up actions with their owners
You can: - explain what a risk is and how to raise one
You can: - follow the rules for spending and ordering - explain how your work is funded
You can: - explain how health IT systems can harm patients, for example through wrong, missing, or delayed information - report a possible clinical safety issue through the right route

You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team - be an advocate for the team externally, and can manage differing perspectives - shape and share communications relevant to the audience
